# Trading agents & frameworks

[← README](../README.md) · [Prediction-market agents →](prediction_markets.md)

Open-source systems where an LLM (or a team of them) reads the market and decides what to trade. Most are research-grade; the `mode` tag says whether a project trades live, paper-trades, or is a study harness.

14 entries, by stars. Add one by editing `data/entries/agents.yaml`.

- [TradingAgents](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents) - Multi-agent LLM framework that mirrors a trading firm (analysts, researchers, trader, risk manager) and produces trade decisions for US equities.  
  `equities` `research` `Python` &nbsp; <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/TauricResearch/TradingAgents?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=stars" alt="stars"> <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/TauricResearch/TradingAgents?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=updated" alt="last commit">

  `equities` `research` `Python` &nbsp; <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/virattt/ai-hedge-fund?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=stars" alt="stars"> <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/virattt/ai-hedge-fund?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=updated" alt="last commit">
